newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Monday, after the spot contract expired lower with a large number of deliveries, traders said.
The spot August contract expired at noon at 125.0 yen per kg, the lowest level this year, down from Friday's close of 127.8 yen. Deliveries totalled 782 lots.

During the day, nearby contracts edged lower due to hedge-selling by trading houses, while distant months were resilient on scattered buying. "Large-than-expected rises in Japanese rubber stocks, announced today, are likely to pressure the market, particularly nearby months," one trader said.
